I feel like Rockstar really needs to shake up the GTA franchise. They should rethink it from the ground up. Stuff like infrared vision or strength augmentation. It would also be cool to have a persistent time mechanic and wanted level. That way you would constantly have to rob people to make rent money and or do/pretend to do side missions to blend in with the normies. Maybe have a disguise feature similar to hitman. They could plan the game around several large story missions with multiple entry points ala Deus Ex. They would require tons of planning and many smaller "informal" missions to properly execute

As for the persistent time thing it would fit in really well with the large mission format. Have each major mission represent a large chunk of time (possibly have a limited number of days to pull of a large job while still having the freedom to choose which side jobs to do); so lets say big story mission one is to rob a bank and you get caught. Instead of reloading, the game continues and you lose x% of y upgrade or what have you plus you miss out on the next major story mission due to jail and/or hospital time. Or better yet they can go hardcore with rouge like permadeath. Although I would personally opt for really expensive illegal clones that start your character at square one, but with full game progress.

Maybe make it into a series of side missions on their own. Find the illegal clone doc/get the right chems/ find and finance a small clandestine cloning facility/ pay off the local cops with bribes or by doing a shady favor. Basically I'd like to be able to do tons of superfluous shit to make tons of tiny incremental upgrades to my character/base/mods/weapons which eventually greatly modify and expand gameplay while making me feel accomplished and actually encouraging me to fuck around more.

I'd also love for things to have more lasting impact. Going back to the time thing; how about I rob that bank, but instead of shooting I tranquilize all the guards so my profile with the police (permawanted level) doesn't go up as much while the various syndicates would respect me more for being a cool operator (thereby allowing me to do more privileged side missions and/or having access to better cronies).

Tying it all together I'd like to go back to GTA 2. The permawanted level would dictate how cops react and how long if at all it would take for them to recognize you based on long/short term heat. Basically they need more dynamic scripted shit to better marry the free roam with the mission stuff.
